column1: # Testing/HDR/hdr-corpus-manifest.tsv - expected clause 8.10 CLASSIFICATION per fixture
# WHY THIS EXISTS SEPARATELY FROM qa-profile-manifest.tsv. That manifest records
# the VALIDATION verdict - valid / warning / noncompliant. It cannot express what
# most of these fixtures were built to pin, because failing clause 8.10.1's
# membership conditions does not make a profile invalid: all six membership
# negatives validate `valid` and are indistinguishable there. This file records
# the other axis - what icGetHdrProfileInfo() concludes - so that a classifier
# which stopped testing one condition fails a row instead of passing silently.
#   purpose            what the fixture is FOR; the only place a reader learns
#                      why a row's numbers are the numbers
# A value of 0 with a source of "-" means not derivable from the profile, which
# is itself an assertion: 8.10.5 d) and the not-Linear case of 8.10.4.
# Floats compare to a relative tolerance of 1e-5, because these are icFloatNumber
# (float, not double) and an exact compare would fail on values like 4,92611.
# ADDING A FIXTURE: add it here AND in Testing/qa-profile-manifest.tsv AND in
# Testing/HDR/mkprofiles.sh/.bat, which is the single source of the build list.
# The test fails on an unlisted profile, so forgetting this file is caught.
